SELECT * FROM(
SELECT s.schedule_sq, 'PERSONAL' AS sourceType, NULL AS projectSq, NULL AS companySq, s.title, s.start_dt AS start_dt, s.end_dt AS end_dt FROM TBL_SCHEDULE_EVNT s JOIN TBL_CALENDAR_INDVDI_EVNT cie ON cie.schedule_sq = s.schedule_sq WHERE s.schedule_user_sq = #{userSq}
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL AS scheduleSq, 'PROJECT' AS sourceType, pj.project_sq AS projectSq, pj.company_sq AS companySq, pj.project_ttl AS projectTtl, pj.project_recruit_start_dt AS project_recruit_start_dt, pj.project_recruit_end_dt AS project_recruit_end_dt FROM TBL_SCRAP_S sc JOIN TBL_PROJECT_M pj ON pj.project_sq = sc.project_sq WHERE sc.user_sq = #{userSq} AND sc.scrap_type_cd = 'PROJECT'
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL as ScheduleSq, 'PROJECT' AS sourceType, pj.project_sq AS projectSq, pj.company_sq AS companySq, pj.project_ttl AS projectTtl, pj.project_recruit_start_dt AS project_recruit_start_dt, pj.project_recruit_end_dt AS project_recruit_end_dt FROM TBL_SCRAP_S sc JOIN TBL_PROJECT_M pj ON pj.company_sq = sc.company_sq WHERE sc.user_sq = #{userSq} AND sc.scrap_type_cd = 'COMPANY' ) u
AND (u.end_dt IS NULL OR u.end_dt >= #{startDt})
AND u.start_dt <= #{endDt}
AND u.sourceType = 'PROJECT'
AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_PROJECT_CONTRACT_TYPE_S pct WHERE pct.project_sq = u.projectSq AND pct.con
AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM TBL_PROJECT_RECRUIT_JOB_ROLE_S prjr WHERE prjr.project_sq = u.projectSq AND prjr.job_type_cd = #{jobTypeCd} )
ORDER BY start_dt
SELECT * FROM TBL_USER_M WHERE user_sq = #{userSq} AND user_is_deleted_yn = 'N'
